# paddle_transaction (Data Source)

Look up an existing Paddle transaction, either directly by `id` or by `subscription_id`/`customer_id`/`status` filters — closes the discovery gap `paddle_adjustment` otherwise has: that action needs both a `transaction_id` and an `item_id`, and `item_id` in particular lives three JSON shapes deep in Paddle's raw API (see `internal/client/lineitem.go`'s doc comment). `line_items` here surfaces exactly the `item_id`/`price_id` pairs `paddle_adjustment`'s config can be built from directly. See https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/transactions/overview. If `id` is set, every other filter is ignored and that transaction is fetched directly. Otherwise, filters are applied server-side and exactly one transaction must match — zero or more than one match is an error, not a silent first-result pick.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `customer_id` (String) Filter by the owning customer's ID (`ctm_...`). Ignored if `id` is set.
- `id` (String) Paddle transaction ID (`txn_...`) to look up directly. Leave unset to look up by the other filters instead.
- `status` (String) Filter by status. Ignored if `id` is set. Also returned (computed) with the matched transaction's actual status.
- `subscription_id` (String) Filter by the owning subscription's ID (`sub_...`). Ignored if `id` is set.

### Read-Only

- `line_items` (Attributes List) This transaction's billed line items, from Paddle's `details.line_items` (a fully-calculated breakdown, distinct from the transaction's own top-level `items` field) — `item_id` here is the exact value `paddle_adjustment`'s `item_id` config expects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items))
- `origin` (String) How this transaction was created, e.g. `subscription_charge`, `subscription_recurring`, `web`, `api`.

<a id="nestedatt--line_items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items`

Read-Only:

- `item_id` (String) Paddle transaction item ID (`txnitm_...`).
- `price_id` (String)
- `quantity` (Number)
